description: This file defines a KeyRotationManager class responsible for managing automated key rotation based on individual key schedules. It includes methods for finding keys needing rotation, performing the rotation, and updating key metadata, with integration to external functions and hooks.

classes.name: KeyRotationManager
classes.description: Manages automated key rotation based on individual key rotation schedules, including finding, rotating, and updating keys, with logging and hook integrations.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the KeyRotationManager with a PrismaClient instance.

methods.name: process_rotations
methods.description: Main method to find and rotate keys that are due for rotation, with logging and error handling.

methods.name: _find_keys_needing_rotation
methods.description: Finds keys that are due for rotation based on their key_rotation_at timestamp and auto_rotate flag.

methods.name: _should_rotate_key
methods.description: Determines if a specific key should be rotated based on current time and key's rotation schedule.

methods.name: _rotate_key
methods.description: Performs the rotation of a single key, updates key metadata, and triggers rotation hooks.
